title: Taking a design system off a Tracy Business EmDash site gives every visitor the template's own light again (UNDO-1), released as 1.7.19 and pinned
steps: S1: run packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-business/tests/theme-preference.test.mjs (the real Base.astro pre-paint and Topbar.astro toggle scripts on one shared storage).
S2: read the theme toggle in src/components/site/Topbar.astro and the pre-paint script in src/layouts/Base.astro.
S4: read tracy-business/emdash in both quickstarts.json copies, the theme's package.json, template.config.json, Dockerfile and the slot contract emdash-tracy-business.json.
expect: S1: passes: a dark system worn then taken off opens light in the same storage, and opening on the system's mode or on ?theme= stores nothing.
S2: only a click stores, under ngi-theme@<id> while a system is worn; Base.astro reads the same key.

S4: both copies pin 1.7.19 on tracy-business-emdash-quickstart-1.7.19.zip (6475347 bytes, sha256 4369ec6c...c26e, asset 638772950) and tracy-business-emdash-state-1.7.19.tar.gz (8472464 bytes, sha256 fb3a181a...2241, asset 638772954); every version and maxVersion say 1.7.19.
fence: No stand, no model, no network. The release is on JoomlArt-Products/ja-products tag tracy-business/emdash-0.x; the measurement was taken on the iMac on the restored release; this case reads only the repo.
